rows.scope: Scoped native comparison: ORAS extracts a directory layer during pull, before IPM's later archive check. A size refusal stops the installed root replacement and records the failure.
source_ranges: Pull: stage, invoke provider, select .tgz, check and return status
Registry.pull: fetches the manifest, writes layers and extracts directory layers
GetModule: status must succeed before returning the stream
LoadModuleReference: consumes stream only after GetModule returns
LoadModuleFromArchive: replaces installed root, extracts and loads
Install records final status; Reinstall delegates through Install

rows.scope: One ordinary exact dependency of a new parent: a catalog and dependency manifest read can return revision 1 while package retrieval and subsequent validation use revision 2 of the same tag.
source_ranges: GetModuleManifest and TagForReference: request constructed from selected name and tag
GetModuleXML: reads the annotation by tag
Exact dependency: retrieves and caches annotation, builds graph node without manifest digest
Fuzzy neighbor uses the same split, source inspection only
LoadDependencies: consumes a separate graph reference
LoadModuleReference: reconstructs reference from graph and platform
VerifyModuleHashAndSize: fresh manifest lookup by tag

source_ranges: Repository modifiers and construction of read client
Service cache keyed by configured repository name
Payload and metadata read interfaces and exact target tag
Dependency lookup, manifest cache and planning boundary
Current pull adapter where raw retrieval must be established
